content.text: Phase list was too large to display; probing phase-id formats so I can get a foundation-model receipt.

input.verdict: Weak support. MEGNet shows mp-23262 gap 2.34 eV (near 2.4 eV photon energy, can absorb) while mp-704645 (0.32 eV) and mp-1692 (0.20 eV) are small-gap Cu-rich phases likely to be poor photoanodes/recombination-prone. Favors the Cu-poor, Bi/V-balanced region (BiVO4-like) of index 3 as the first probe.

input.verdict: Largely uninformative for this candidate: MACE confirms mp-704645 is CuO (on hull, small gap), which argues against very Cu-rich compositions. Index 27 (Cu 0.47, V 0.45, Bi 0.09) targets the Cu-vanadate region (Cu3V2O8/Cu2V2O7-type, ~2 eV gaps) rather than CuO, exploring a different region from index 3.

content.text: Last merit measurement: I'm testing the Cu₃V₂O₈-like region (index 57), because the Cu-V side has scored best so far.

input.verdict: Against going further Cu-rich. mp-1692 has a small gap (0.4 eV GLLB), which argues against CuO-dominated compositions. Index 57 (Cu 0.61, V 0.32, Bi 0.08) stays on the Cu-vanadate line near Cu3V2O8 stoichiometry. That is where the best merit so far was measured (idx 27, 1.53 uA vs 0.9 uA for the BiVO4-like idx 3).

input.rationale: Index 27 (Bi 0.09, Cu 0.47, V 0.45) had the highest photocurrent of the three merit measurements: 1.53 uA. It sits in the low-Bi region where Cu:V is roughly 1:1, the Cu-vanadate region.

rejected.reason: The BiVO4-like Bi/V-rich composition gave only 0.9 uA.
The more Cu-rich composition near Cu3V2O8 gave 0.71 uA. Photocurrent drops as Cu increases, which fits the small-gap CuO phases predicted by MEGNet/MACE.

content.text:
I submitted **index 27** (Bi 0.09, Cu 0.47, V 0.45) as the best composition. It had the highest photocurrent of the three I measured, but three samples from a library of 188 is thin coverage. I can't tell how close it is to the best composition in the library.

| Index | Composition (Bi / Cu / V) | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 27 | 0.09 / 0.47 / 0.45 | **1.53 µA** |
| 3 | 0.36 / 0.21 / 0.43 (Bi-V rich, like BiVO₄) | 0.90 µA |
| 57 | 0.08 / 0.61 / 0.32 (near Cu₃V₂O₈) | 0.71 µA |

- **Trend:** photocurrent peaked where Cu and V are roughly equal and Bi is low. It fell when I moved toward more Bi or more Cu.
- **Model predictions:** the models didn't guide the choices much. I couldn't read the phase list because it was too large to display, so I found valid phase IDs by guessing. What I got suggested a Cu-poor start: MACE confirmed one phase was CuO, and MEGNet predicted small band gaps (0.2–0.4 eV) for the Cu-rich phases I found. It predicted 2.34 eV for another phase whose formula I didn't check. After index 3 scored lowest, I followed the measurements rather than that prediction.
- **Budget:** all 3 merit measurements are used. I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so no phases in these samples were identified.
- **Not measured:** the Gaussian-process model's top picks after two measurements were indices 25, 120, 79, 135 and 122. Most sit near index 27 with a bit more Bi or V. Those, and anything else not measured, earn nothing.
